answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The pearl edge is logged both ways, so a closed ring of 37 clones produces a signature the nadir analysis flags immediately. Anyone must thus build an open graph reaching real agents, and as a result doing work rather than printing keys, and the lagoon settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 6 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
